units.source_text: 大竹七段为思考这五手，时而把双手揣在怀里，

en.t: To think through these five moves, Otake 7-dan would sometimes tuck both hands into his robe,

units.source_text: 时而交抱双臂，时而又两手扶在双膝旁，

en.t: sometimes fold his arms across his chest, and sometimes rest both hands beside his knees,

units.source_text: 或者去收拾棋盘上连肉眼也看不见的灰尘，

en.t: or brush away dust from the go board that was not even visible to the naked eye,

units.source_text: 还把对手的白子翻过来。

en.t: and he would even turn over his opponent's white stones.
In fact, he was turning the front side upward.

units.source_text: 若说白子有正反面之分，那么蛤贝内侧、没有纹理那面是正面。

en.t: If one says that white stones have a front and a back, then the front is the inner side of the clam shell, the side without markings.

units.source_text: 这种事情，谁都不会在意。

en.t: No one would pay attention to such a thing.

units.source_text: 然而大竹七段有时却将名人无所谓地下的反面白子，抓起来翻个个儿。

en.t: Yet Otake 7-dan would sometimes pick up a white stone that the Meijin had casually played upside down and turn it over.
